title: geonoma multiflora subsp. negrensis
intro: Geonoma multiflora subsp. negrensis, commonly known as a species of palm tree, is a type of plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to treat various conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geonoma multiflora subsp. negrensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
